title: Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World
native_title: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活
source: Re:Zero light novels / web novel by Tappei Nagatsuki (ongoing). Snapshots use the latest published arc.
world: Shut-in Subaru Natsuki is suddenly summoned to a fantasy world and discovers Return by Death: when he dies, he returns to an earlier checkpoint with his memories. He serves Emilia, a half-elf candidate in the royal selection for the Kingdom of Lugunica, at Roswaal's mansion with the twin maids Rem and Ram. Each arc forces Subaru through deaths and loops to save the people he loves. Dark, emotional and full of hard-won growth.
power_system: Magic uses mana and elements (fire, water, wind, earth, yin, yang). Spirits make contracts with people. The Witch Cult's Archbishops of Sin hold Witch Factors. Subaru's Return by Death cannot be told to anyone; trying causes pain.
